MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The microSD card fits my interest in storage and Raspberry Pi projects, provided its format and capacity work with my devices.",
    "The USB headset fits my repeated interest in headphones and practical computer accessories, and I can see a clear use for it during computer calls."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Disc repair supplies and a car lens cleaner do not address the computer cleaning and organization needs reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "The car antenna adapter, HP battery, and Apple laptop memory require specific equipment or repair needs that I have not established.",
    "The Blu-ray player, surround-sound receiver, and speakers assume I want to build an entertainment setup, while I am currently more interested in useful computer accessories and my headphone setup."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics accessories seems to have been taken as interest in electronics for unrelated purposes, including car audio and home theater.",
    "My computer maintenance purchases seem to have been interpreted as a general need for cleaning and repair products, regardless of what equipment they serve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, network cables, headphone mount, and computer duster point toward improving and maintaining a working computer setup.",
    "Compatibility matters: my storage purchases do not establish that I need a 512GB card, and owning laptop accessories does not establish which replacement battery or memory would fit.",
    "My Raspberry Pi and headphone purchases provide more specific reasons to consider related accessories than a broad interest in audio or electronics does."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in computer accessories but stretched it into unrelated entertainment equipment and repairs without a clear current need."
}
